S.FORM: malumaingay a dawa i kasumamadan u kakitaan a tademaw nu Cong-kow u kakaydihay a sasang'a tu zikuc , sisa kauzipan a tademaw, nu Cong-kow caay kalasawad, mutesek ku kalilid tu palahad kacakat nu laylay nu Cong-kow, uzuma satu Si-han ci Cang-say a tademawan tayza i Si-yi mala, muculil tuyni "Si-lu" a zazanan a singanganay. makayza i Cong-kuw satipan nuwamisan milakui' tu talakaway Pa-mi-al a buyu' ciniza, katukuh ayzaay a Pakistan atu Iran, u sabaatay katukuh i O-cuo, mibuhat tu saculilan a laed nu Cung-si , lumaingay a dawa nu Cong-kow patayzaen i nutawan a kanatal, malecad aca u Cung, Si a lalangawan u saayaway a malalacal, mahiza u i labuay mahiza u baatay. == namakayniay a nasulitan nasakamuan atu natinengan ==
S.PHON: ma[r|ɾ]umaiŋaj a dawa i kasumamadan u kakitaan a tadəmaw nu ʦoŋkow u kakajdiħaj a sasaŋ[ʔ|ʡ]a tu zikuʦ sisa kauzipan a tadəmaw nu ʦoŋkow ʦaaj ka[r|ɾ]asawad mutəsək ku ka[r|ɾ]i[r|ɾ]id tu pa[r|ɾ]aħad kaʦakat nu [r|ɾ]aj[r|ɾ]aj nu ʦoŋkow uzuma satu siħan ʦi ʦaŋsaj a tadəmawan tajza i siji ma[r|ɾ]a muʦu[r|ɾ]i[r|ɾ] tujni si[r|ɾ]u a zazanan a siŋaŋanaj makajza i ʦoŋkuw satipan nuwamisan mi[r|ɾ]akui[ʔ|ʡ] tu ta[r|ɾ]akawaj pamia[r|ɾ] a buju[ʔ|ʡ] ʦiniza katukuħ ajzaaj a pakistan atu iran u sabaataj katukuħ i oʦuo mibuħat tu saʦu[r|ɾ]i[r|ɾ]an a [r|ɾ]aəd nu ʦuŋsi [r|ɾ]umaiŋaj a dawa nu ʦoŋkow patajzaən i nutawan a kanata[r|ɾ] ma[r|ɾ]əʦad aʦa u ʦuŋ si a [r|ɾ]a[r|ɾ]aŋawan u saajawaj a ma[r|ɾ]a[r|ɾ]aʦa[r|ɾ] maħiza u i [r|ɾ]abuaj maħiza u baataj namakajniaj a nasu[r|ɾ]itan nasakamuan atu natinəŋan
